patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Todoist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Todoist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Jira only if your buying job matches “Atlassian Agile issue tracker for software teams — Free ≤10; Standard from ~$8.15/user/mo ” rather than Todoist's shape. Choose Todoist only if your buying job matches “Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$6.25/user/” rather than Jira's shape. Workflow advantage: Jira leans work-management; Todoist leans shared coverage. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Jira and Todoist share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Jira is Atlassian Agile issue tracker for software teams — Free ≤10; Standard from ~$8.15/user/mo annual.; Todoist is Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$6.25/user/mo annual; Business ~$10..
- Company-size focus: Jira (small-business, mid-market, enterprise) vs Todoist (micro, small-business, mid-market).
- Workflow coverage skew: Jira-leaning work-management vs Todoist-leaning —.
- Researched limits: Jira — Steep learning curve outside engineering; Todoist — Not a Work OS or portfolio tool.

Limitations — Jira: Steep learning curve outside engineering; Confluence often required for wiki/docs depth; Todoist: Not a Work OS or portfolio tool; Team features mainly on Business.

Poor-fit cases: Jira is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Steep learning curve outside engineering · Todoist is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a Work OS or portfolio tool · Avoid Jira if you actually need Todoist's motion (Personal and team task manager with natural-language capture — Free; Pro from ~$)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
